chk_problem.reason: Both drafts identify the lack of reflection and failure recovery capabilities in noisy environments as the core problem.

chk_method.reason: Both drafts identify the Agent-Reflex framework consisting of RSD, ReSFT, and ORPO stages.

chk_data.reason: Both drafts describe the dataset components, including the 557 environments and 1,170 reflection meta-skills.

chk_setup.reason: Both drafts identify the evaluation setup using Qwen3-8B across six benchmarks (five long-horizon benchmarks plus AgentNoiseBench).

chk_primary_result.reason: Both drafts report the exact same performance numbers (58.6 overall on five benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench).

chk_secondary_result.reason: Both drafts identify improved robustness to noise and stable training dynamics as the secondary results.

chk_baseline.reason: Both drafts identify reflection methods and environment-scaling methods as the baseline categories, with minor differences in specific examples and additional categories.

chk_conclusion.reason: Both drafts conclude that Agent-Reflex successfully improves long-horizon tool use and robustness under noise.

chk_limitation.reason: Both drafts identify the limitation that the skill library does not automatically adapt to changes in tool interfaces or environment dynamics.
